The '''Star Jammers''' was a small group of independent [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the decades preceding it, raided [[Starship/Legends|starships]] across multiple [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] without ever being captured. They were able to do so by using several new [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes that they had discovered, striking in unexpected locations and escaping the authorities.
